description: This Java class, GlobalCommandRegistry, manages the registry of command types for deserialization within the Ditto framework. It implements singleton pattern, resolves command types from JSON objects, and contains factories and strategies for parsing commands based on annotations.

classes.name: GlobalCommandRegistry
classes.description: A singleton registry class that handles deserialization strategies for Command subclasses based on JSON type fields, integrating multiple parsing strategies and utilizing annotations.

classes.name: GlobalCommandRegistry.CommandParsingStrategyFactory
classes.description: A nested class that provides methods to generate parsing keys and method names based on command annotation metadata for JSON deserialization.

methods.name: GlobalCommandRegistry.getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of GlobalCommandRegistry.

methods.name: GlobalCommandRegistry.resolveType
methods.description: Resolves and returns the command type string from a given JsonObject, falling back to version 1 format or throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: GlobalCommandRegistry.extractTypeV1
methods.description: Extracts the command type from legacy version 1 JSON format, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: GlobalCommandRegistry.CommandParsingStrategyFactory.getV1FallbackKeyFor
methods.description: Provides fallback key for command parsing based on annotation, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: GlobalCommandRegistry.CommandParsingStrategyFactory.getKeyFor
methods.description: Constructs parsing key for commands based on annotation prefix and name.

methods.name: GlobalCommandRegistry.CommandParsingStrategyFactory.getMethodNameFor
methods.description: Returns the method name for parsing commands based on annotation metadata.
